groups.defect: The sender verification unconditionally indexes optional sender metadata, causing exceptions for missing or null values, and compares GitHub logins case-sensitively, potentially rejecting legitimate installers.
groups.rationale: All five report the same unguarded sender lookup at lines 500–505. The merged comment must also preserve the null-sender case from s_412f55af and the case-sensitive comparison defect explicitly reported by s_faf6b973.
